messages:
Priya: Heads-up  two partner folks arriving 3:15pm for a quick sync. Do they need preregistration or can they check in?
Front Desk: Pre-reg preferred but same-day works. Please email full names + company to reception@redwood.com so we can print badges.
Ben: Also can we hold two hot desks by the whiteboard? Desk app won't show visitors.
People Ops: We can reserve those seats once you send names. Note: guest Wi-Fi is Guest-Redwood (24h). If they need temporary Okta access for a demo, include emails for a 48h guest account.
Priya: One of them wants to ship a small prototype today. Where should courier drop it?
MailRoom: Ship to: "Redwood Inference - Front Desk
Attn: Priya (Partner visit)
[Office street address]". If >20lb route to Receiving and mark "Receiving". Add "Fragile" if needed and include tracking in your email to reception@redwood.com.
CheckinBot: visitor_precheck: 2 guests pre-registered by Priya. Badges queued 15:03.
Priya: Got it  sending names + tracking now, thanks :thumbsup:
